text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(...The air is clear, and the stars are 
easy to see. It feels like it'll be a 
pleasant run tonight.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(...? Someone's out on the track... Even 
at this hour—)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Just a little more.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(............ And here I thought I could 
train alone—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...No use fretting over it...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(This isn't running together. It's just 
individuals running side-by-side—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Even though we should be right next to 
each other, it feels so far away. But—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(This feeling... isn't half bad. I feel 
like I could run forever.)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*, *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, whew*...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(...So dazzling, completely alone, and no 
matter how far I chased after it, I could 
never reach it—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(The way this girl runs, it's almost 
like——)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No, it's nothing. Are you still 
running tonight?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. A little longer. Um, may I go now?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Well then, excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Just a little more for me too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And then, as if sharing a long, quiet 
conversation, the two of them continued 
running along the night track endlessly—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"From that night onward, Admire Vega's 
running grew even more fierce."
